$comment: Mission 1.37 §36, §24, §25. The CONTRACT a calibration reference dataset must satisfy. It contains NO examples, real or invented: §36 forbids populating it with invented examples presented as real labels, and an example in a schema is the thing a later reader copies. `units` and `labels` are empty by design and their emptiness is the honest state of the system.

dataset_identity.immutability: A dataset_version is immutable once any experiment references it. A correction creates a new version and never edits a label in place (§25).

reference_origin.contract: Mission 1.25 ReferenceOrigin, required on every label and never defaulted
reference_origin.human_ground_truth_established: true only when EVERY label in the set is human. All, never any: a mixed set reported as true would be read as unmixed.

unit_schema.name: ClaimEvidenceSnapshot
unit_schema.one_unit_is: one Claim revision with its COMPLETE eligible Evidence set as aggregation saw it

unit_id.note: stable, and derived from the content rather than from creation order

claim_revision.note: a claim reworded in a later revision is a different unit; the aggregation was over that wording

claim_feature.note: null is legitimate and means no half-life applies; it is not a missing value to fill

domain.note: recorded for the bias evaluation and for the second-pilot diversity requirement

evidence_set_is_complete.note: a unit built from a subset is a unit about a different evidence set

evidence_snapshot_digest.note: the engine's own digest, so the unit can be checked against a re-run

per_evidence.note: reliability is recorded as RESOLVED plus its binding, never as a copy on the evidence row: scoring.evidence.reliability is NULL by design (ADR-026 Decision 2)

verified_lineage.note: which record derived from which, established rather than assumed. Independence is the model's most load-bearing input, so a dataset without traced lineage cannot calibrate it. D-12 blocks the automatic form; until then this is annotated by hand and the annotation carries provenance.
verified_lineage.empty_means: no lineage was traced, which forces every record to UNKNOWN and must be recorded as such rather than read as independence

aggregation_output.note: recorded so a re-run can be checked, NOT as a target. The model's own output is never the label.

leakage_group_key.note: the (reliability_scope, proposition_kind, subject_key) tuple, rendered. Every unit sharing it must share a split.

label_schema.why_pairs: the absolute score scale has no anchor (strategy correction C-2), so a reviewer can defensibly order two evidence sets and cannot defensibly place one on an absolute scale

reviewer_id.note: a named accountable person; 'operator' and other impersonal placeholders are refused, following the reliability recorder's precedent

presentation_order_seed.note: pairs are shown in randomised order and the seed is recorded, so an order effect can be measured rather than argued about

reviewer_saw_model_output.note: a reviewer who has seen the score is no longer independent

rationale.note: free text, retained for audit, never parsed into a number

confidence_self_reported.note: deliberately absent. A self-reported certainty is not a probability, and the only safe handling is to never do arithmetic on it, at which point asking buys nothing (Mission 1.24 precedent).

disagreement.representation: every reviewer's judgement is retained as its own row. Judgements are never averaged into a consensus value.
disagreement.majority_vote: refused as the default. Disagreement on a pair is often information about the pair rather than an error by one reviewer.
disagreement.irreconcilable: a permitted terminal state. A pair two qualified reviewers order differently after adjudication is evidence the pair is near-indistinguishable, and forcing a resolution manufactures a label.

revision.note: a corrected label creates a new dataset version. A label a historical profile was scored against is never overwritten, or that profile becomes unverifiable.

invariants: every unit belongs to exactly one split
every unit sharing a leakage_group_key shares a split
development and holdout labels are stored in SEPARATE FILES, so a development loader cannot reach a holdout label by forgetting to filter
the manifest is frozen and hashed before any parameter is fitted

temporal_variant.required_when: any claim of temporal generalisation, and any fitted half-life
temporal_variant.rule: a cut date, fit before it, evaluate after it. A random shuffle across time is not temporal validation.

coverage_report_schema.note: required BEFORE any fitting. A dataset that has not reported its coverage cannot be judged adequate, and the empty cells are the point.

echo_hazard_check.rule: the count of units whose limiting component is NOT reliability must be reported. A dataset where reliability limits every unit can only measure reliability pass-through.

emptiness_is_the_state: No unit, no label and no manifest exists. Nothing here has been populated with an example, because an example in a schema is what a later reader copies, and a fabricated label is indistinguishable from a real one once it has been copied.
